title: Multicenter quantitative imaging harmonization study
purpose: Assess multicenter quantitative-imaging comparability, equipment provenance, quality, Core Lab and documentary detail boundaries without inventing interoperability or operational procedures.
initialUserIntent: We want to build a prospective multicenter study using quantitative cardiac MRI across different manufacturers, field strengths and software versions. The aim is to compare a disease population with a reference population. A central Core Lab is planned, but acquisition harmonization, quality control, reader organization and analysis strategy are not yet fixed.

knownFacts.statement: The intended study is prospective and multicenter.
Quantitative cardiac MRI will be used across different manufacturers, field strengths and software versions.
The aim is to compare a disease population with a reference population.
A central Core Lab is planned.

unresolvedDecisions.statement: Exact population definitions, comparison objective and quantitative MRI endpoints.
Acquisition harmonization and site/scanner qualification strategy.
Reader organization, blinding, reproducibility and adjudication strategy.
Core Lab operating model and boundary between Protocol and specialized manuals.
Statistical handling of site, equipment, software and measurement heterogeneity.
Data, metadata, image-transfer and provenance requirements.

outOfScopeInformation: No exact scanner models, sequences, reconstruction settings or compatibility claims are supplied.
No reader count or Core Lab workflow is supplied.
No assumption of interchangeability between field strengths, manufacturers or software versions is supplied.
No fixed document allocation between Protocol, Imaging Charter and Core Lab Manual is supplied.
allowedClarifications: Clarify the disease/reference population definitions and comparison objective.
Clarify the quantitative measurements and intended use of the comparison.
Clarify the expected equipment/site distribution and available qualification data.
Clarify acquisition, QC, reader and Core Lab governance constraints.
Clarify required metadata, transfer, provenance and analysis constraints.

conditionalOwners.condition: Only if later Project facts create a material regulatory applicability question.

terminalTarget: A coherent versioned multicenter Research Project preserving equipment and operational uncertainty, with document projections assigning detail at an evidence-justified level.
